description: Recent event logs for any contract on Base over a bounded recent window (reads eth_getLogs). Optionally filter by topic0 (event signature hash). Returns up to 50 logs with block, tx hash, topics and data. Window is limited by the RPC log-range quota. Use this for generic event queries not covered by whale-wallet-tracker or token-deploy-radar. Price: 0.0050 USDC per call (premium: always paid).

address.description: Contract address (0x...) to read logs from

topic0.description: Optional 32-byte event signature hash (0x...) to filter by

name: contract-logs
title: Contract Logs
